prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1323; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. For the file, can you confirm you were driving your vehicle at the time of the collision?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car.

Q: Where were you when the accident happened?

A: I was in League City, Texas, on the main road near the shopping center. I was trying to change lanes to get into the turn lane.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you moved over.

A: I checked my mirror and it looked clear. I signaled and started moving into the lane. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed a little to the right. The other car had come up in my blind spot.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: No, I didn't see it. I think it was in the spot my mirror doesn't cover well.

Q: How fast were you going?

A: I'd say around the speed limit, maybe a little slower because I was slowing for the turn.

Q: Did you stop after the contact or keep driving?

A: I pulled into the parking lot right away and stopped. The other driver stopped too.

Q: Were you hurt in the accident?

A: Yes, my lower back hurts. I felt a sharp twinge when the car jerked, and it's gotten stiffer since then.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment yet?

A: I went to urgent care that afternoon. They checked me out and told me it looked like a back strain. I've been taking the medication they gave me and I'm doing some stretches.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and my back feeling better.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
